predicted_reason: These handcrafted decorative copper relief wall plaques are classified under chapter 76 of the HTSUS, which covers other manufactures not elsewhere classified. The specific subheading 7617.90.9000 covers copper sheet goods, such as the decorative wall plaques, which are handcrafted and made from 24-gauge copper sheet with a clear protective lacquer coating.
